threshold_basis: Predeclared EOD hypotheses, not Ross parameters or optimized thresholds. Nineteen prior observations use the existing validated 20-bar sidecar without including the signal bar. RVOL 2 is an exploratory daily-volume ablation; Ross intraday RVOL is not equivalent. Five sessions preserves the existing tactical maximum. 2R is a hypothetical profit-management reference, not observed resistance. Gap tolerance 0.25R tests a bounded delayed entry. Costs are per-side spread/slippage/fee sensitivities, not verified executions; no paid services added.
promotion: No automatic promotion, retuning, risk changes or allocation changes. Review net incremental evidence across distinct nonoverlapping forward cohorts and market conditions, include failures/missing coverage, execution feasibility and costs. Version any change before new observations. Owner approval required for capital/risk changes.
